footnote: Source: CADPA, China Game Industry Reports 2015 to 2025. Multiple and annual growth calculated
notes: In ten years, overseas revenue from China-developed games went from US$5.31 billion to US$20.455 billion. That is 3.85 times, about 14.4% a year, against about 9.6% a year at home. Both rates are my calculations. But it is not a one-way street. It fell 3.70% in 2022 and another 5.65% in 2023, a year when the home market grew 13.95%. Overseas revenue can fall, and it can fall while home is doing well. One note on definitions: until 2018 the association counted self-developed online games, from 2019 self-developed games. The year-on-year rates connect, but the name changed.
